evidence.quote: Our study evaluated a single task with open-weight models (Qwen3.5 0.8B and 27B) and two frontier models (Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview and Claude Opus 4.6).
More benchmarking and experiments are needed to determine the generality of these findings.

All LLM methods in this benchmark operate without tools or external knowledge retrieval. Equipping LLM optimizers with agentic capabilities such as paper search, documentation lookup, or code analysis tools is a promising direction.
Additionally, exploring other classical optimizers as the hybrid base and pairing CMA-ES with a code-editing LLM agent could allow the search space to co-evolve with the optimization trajectory.
